title.narrative: Reducing HIV infections and HIV related mortality among Somalis - Somalia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Somalia, HIV, United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections by 30% by 2020. Reduce HIV related morbidity and mortality by 30% by 2020. Strengthened Enabling Environment. Reduce maternal and child mortality. The objectives of this program are: Reduce Sexually acquired HIV infections. Increase the percentage of people who know their HIV status. Reduce the prevalence of and mordbity from STIs. Reduce the transmission of HIV from mother to child. Increase the percentage of people living with HIV to be alive on treatment 12 months after initiation of ART. Reduce HIV related vulnerabilities. Reduce the impact of TB HIV comorbdiity. Strengthened Monitoring and Evaluation. Strengthened Program Capacity, Coordination and Management. To increase access to and utilization of cost-effective, quality and gender-sensitive health services especially for women, children, and other vulnerable groups
